description: This file is a C header defining a Key-Value Pair (KVP) framework for unit testing, including status codes, data structures, and function declarations for creating, destroying, parsing, and retrieving key-value data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_createInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new KVP instance handle.

methods.name: ut_kvp_destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources for a given KVP instance handle.

methods.name: ut_kvp_open
methods.description: Opens and parses a KVP file into a KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_openMemory
methods.description: Parses a KVP payload from caller-owned memory into an instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_close
methods.description: Closes and frees a KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getBoolField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt8Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint8_t value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt16Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint16_t value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt32Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32_t value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt64Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getStringField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a key, copying it into provided buffer.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getFloatField
methods.description: Retrieves a float value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDoubleField
methods.description: Retrieves a double value associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_fieldPresent
methods.description: Checks if a key is present in the KVP profile.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getData
methods.description: Returns a heap-allocated string representation of the entire KVP data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of list entries for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDataBytes
methods.description: Returns the data bytes associated with a key, managing memory for caller.

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR,   \/**!< Failed to open the file. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND,     \/**!< Key not found in the KVP instance. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX                \/**!< Out of range marker (not a valid status). *\/$/
